INSPECTION OF SOLENOID RESISTOR

INSPECT RESISTANCE OF SOLENOID RESISTOR
Using an ohmmeter, measure the resistance between +B and other terminals.
Resistance:    3 Ω each
If the resistance is not as specified, replace the resistor.
